{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Under President Biden, the United States is championing a modern industrial and innovation strategy domestically and with international partners.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States’ industrial and innovation strategy focuses on bolstering economic and technological strengths.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States’ industrial and innovation strategy promotes diverse and resilient global supply chains.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States’ industrial and innovation strategy sets high standards for labor, environmental practices, trusted technology, and good governance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States’ industrial and innovation strategy aims to channel capital towards delivering public goods such as climate solutions and healthcare advancements.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America's prosperity and the prosperity of its allies and partners are mutually reinforcing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Under President Biden's leadership, companies from American allies are building cutting-edge factories in the United States, employing hundreds of thousands of Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. partners provide critical materials, expertise, and products the world needs to achieve global climate goals.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. partners are important markets for U.S. goods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trade with allies and partners on fair terms promotes growth and reinforces alliances.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will mobilize tens of billions of dollars to invest in clean energy development and critical infrastructure with high labor standards around the world through the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework (IPEF), the Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment, the Americas Partnership for Economic Prosperity, and bilateral initiatives such as the U.S.-Kenya Strategic Trade and Investment Partnership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Investments through the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework (IPEF), the Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment, the Americas Partnership for Economic Prosperity, and bilateral initiatives such as the U.S.-Kenya Strategic Trade and Investment Partnership will result in high-quality growth.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Investments through the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework (IPEF), the Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment, the Americas Partnership for Economic Prosperity, and bilateral initiatives such as the U.S.-Kenya Strategic Trade and Investment Partnership will increase supply chain resilience.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Investments through the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework (IPEF), the Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment, the Americas Partnership for Economic Prosperity, and bilateral initiatives such as the U.S.-Kenya Strategic Trade and Investment Partnership will contribute to progress toward global climate goals.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
